measurement: P0 seed sensitivity — is 32.0% a number or a coincidence?
findings: THE SEED WORKS: ZERO of 200 generations is identical between the two seeds. Any agreement below is about rates, not about outputs.

七絕 gives 32.0% on BOTH seeds — but 24 of its 50 poems FLIPPED verdict (12 each way). The agreement is a balanced coincidence at the margin, NOT low variance. Two seeds landing on the same point does not tighten the estimate.
At n=50 and p≈0.32 the binomial SE is 6.6pp, so P0's '< 40%' threshold sits about 1.2 SE above the estimate. That is the honest precision of the headline, and it was not improved by a second seed.
七律 moved 40.0% -> 12.0%, 28pp, about 3.2 SE on the two-draw difference. That is beyond sampling noise on two draws and it is far larger than any plausible LoRA effect.
So P2/P3 must NOT be scored on 七律 from a single seed: the seed variance would swamp the training effect being measured. 七絕 and 五絕 are the steadier forms and even they carry ±6.6pp.
bounds: TWO SEEDS. Two draws cannot characterise a distribution; 七律's excursion is flagged, not modelled.
The SE figures assume independent Bernoulli trials across topics, which is not obviously true — the topics are mine and some may be systematically easier.
Same prompt template, same temperature, same model, same verifier throughout.
